_purpose: Internal work-tracking only, for the differentiator-framework-coverage scheduled task's own picker. Not read by any pipeline script and not member-facing data. A framework listed here is skipped by the routine WITHOUT re-investigation as long as neither its awarded-supplier set nor its refused-crawl list has changed since 'checkedOn'.
